item.title: Paged KV cache explained
item.dc:creator: Alice
item.description: A short teaser about paged KV cache.
item.content:encoded:
PagedAttention stores the KV cache in fixed-size blocks, much like virtual memory pages in an operating system.

This lets the serving engine allocate memory on demand and share prefix blocks between requests, which raises batch size and throughput.
